title: Recovery after state relabeling
statement: Let $d$ be a configuration whose state is the left-left injection of some $e\in S_0$. Relabel every state of $d$ by the constant value $e$, then inject the resulting state first into $S_0\oplus S_1$ and then into $(S_0\oplus S_1)\oplus S_2$. The resulting configuration is $d$.
